newsitem.title: UK: Land Securities up amid upbeat comment.
newsitem.headline: Land Securities up amid upbeat comment.

text.p: Shares in Land Securities Plc and British Land Co Plc rose on Wednesday, amid positive comments on the sector from analysts at BZW and in the Times newspaper, dealers and analysts said.

With prices squeezed higher by a shortage of stock in the market, Land Securities shares were up 20p at 920-1/2 by 0943 GMT in volume of just over one million shares, while British Land Plc was up 11-1/2p at 587-1/2.

The Times's Tempus column said Chancellor (finance minister) Gordon Brown was engineering a property boom with his plan to cut the dividend tax credit on shares -- prompting investment funds to flock into commercial property in search of higher yield.
Separately BZW repeated an "overweight" recommendation on the sector for similar reasons, dealers said. Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available.
